description: Manages core administrative operations for the system, including infrastructure maintenance and database schema updates.

endpoints.name: RunMigrations
endpoints.description: Initiates and executes any pending database migrations to update the system's data schema to the latest required version. This is a critical operation typically performed during system deployment or upgrade cycles to ensure data consistency and compatibility with new application features.
example_uses: Run the database migrations for the system.
Execute all pending schema updates for the application.
Can you trigger the system's database migration process now?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when the system's database schema needs to be updated to the latest version, typically after a new application deployment or an upgrade that introduces changes to the data model. This ensures the application can function correctly with the underlying data structure.
